text.p: Office supplies group Corporate Express Australia Ltd said on Wednesday it planned a one-for-five non-renounceable rights issue.
The issue of not more than 15.52 million shares at a price of 85 cents a share would raise just over A$13 million, it said.
Corporate Express said the purpose of the issue was to increase the company's net tangible assets by raising additional working capital and reducing debt.
The company said it had positioned itself as a leader in its markets through acquisition and warehouse consolidations.
The capital raising, together with the completion in April 1997 of remaining warehouse consolidations in Victoria, would enable it to capitalise on future opportunities.
Corporate Express said its issue prospectus would be sent to shareholders registered January 31 by February 6.
